content.text:
Chicago has issued **52** building permits for 121 N LaSalle St since January 1, 2015.

I searched the city's building permits dataset for street number 121 on LaSalle St with an issue date on or after 2015-01-01. All 52 records have different permit numbers, so no permit is counted twice. The most recent one was issued on 2026-02-19 for structural repairs to the sub-basement floor.

The 52 permits include:
- Quarterly maintenance permits for AT&T telephone and wiring work
- Elevator modernization and hoist rope replacements
- Repairs to the outside walls, plus the scaffolding permits for that work
- Chiller and cooling tower replacements
